title: Pub dedicated to the Gravity Research Foundation

tellings.quote: you live pretty close to this pub that is uh dedicated to the grav gravity research foundation I believe uh you know this work of Roger Babson

plain: In New Hampshire there is said to be a pub dedicated to the Gravity Research Foundation, a group the businessman Roger Babson set up to study gravity and ways to overcome it. Michels brings it up himself while talking with Ryan Graves, a former Navy fighter pilot who saw UFOs, noting that Graves lives close to the pub.
